content.short: NorthOne is a US small-business banking app with Envelopes budgeting, payments, a debit card and integrations.
content.description: NorthOne is a US business banking app built for small businesses, freelancers and startups that want straightforward money management. Through a partner bank it offers a business checking account, a debit card, and its signature Envelopes feature that automatically sets money aside for taxes, payroll and expenses. NorthOne also supports ACH and wire payments, bill pay, mobile check deposit, and integrations with accounting and e-commerce tools, giving owners a clear view of cash flow. By focusing on budgeting-style envelopes and simple payments rather than sprawling product suites, it helps main-street businesses stay organized, plan ahead and keep their finances under control from one app.
